name: Kamishiro Aoi
source:
An agent of the Vatican's Special Service Agency "Rubina." She came to town with [url=/c34611]Lycoris[/url], after getting information that an important vampire is there.

Aoi is one of a few people who can communicate directly with God. She has spent her whole life killing monsters, it is the top priority order assigned to her. Aoi prefers physical work over cognitive thinking and focuses on things in the moment without considering the future.

Her specialty is a combination attack with two swords, using her above average physical ability. Her purpose is freeing her partner Lycoris who became [url=/c34612]Iris's[/url] familiar spirit, so she will move together with [url=/c39402]Shuuma[/url] for a while.

[From [url=http://prefundia.com/projects/view/libra-of-the-vampire-princess-bishoujo-game-english-version/6962/]Prefundia[/url]]
